Copy.

April 17, 1930.

Report on Lawrence Paterson.

Lawrence Paterson arrived in Shanghai from
Singapore on the s.s. "Beltana" at 11 a.m. April 16th.
He was met on arrival and when interrogated
volunteered the following particulars regarding himself:-
Name, Lawrence Paterson, aged 34, British
Eurasian, born in Shanghai of British father and Chinese
mother. His father was in the Royal marines and died in
Shanghai in 1910. Paterson was educated in the St. Francis
Xaviers College, No. 23 Nanking Road, and in 1913 left
Shanghai for England. At the outbreak of the Great War
he joined the R.F.A. and served in France until 1918
when he was transferred for Garrison duty in India. Soon
afterwards he was discharged and then proceeded to
Singapore where he obtained a position with the A.P.C.
which he held for about four years and was then discharged
for (according to him) some unknown reason.
As far as could be learned he then commenced a
wandering life and eventually, being in distress, gave
himself up to the Singapore Police who paid his passage
to Shanghai.
Paterson had no money but stated he would apply
to the Xaviers College Authorities for assistance until
such as he could find employment. He has no permanent
residence.

副本。

1930年4月17日。

关于劳伦斯·帕特森的报告。

劳伦斯·帕特森于4月16日上午11时乘“贝尔塔纳”号轮船（s.s. "Beltana"）从新加坡抵达上海。他在抵达时受到接见，并在接受讯问时主动提供了以下关于其个人的情况：姓名，劳伦斯·帕特森，34岁，英籍欧亚混血儿，生于上海，父亲为英国人，母亲为中国人。其父曾在皇家海军陆战队服役，于1910年在上海去世。帕特森曾就读于南京路23号的圣方济各沙勿略学院（St. Francis Xaviers College），并于1913年离开上海前往英国。大战爆发时，他加入皇家野战炮兵队（R.F.A.），在法国服役至1918年，随后被调往印度执行卫戍任务。不久后他退役，随即前往新加坡，在那里获得了一份在 A.P.C. 的工作，任职约四年后，因（据他称）某些不明原因被解雇。据查，他此后开始了流浪生活，最终因陷入困境而向新加坡警方自首，由警方支付其船费遣送其至上海。帕特身无分文，但表示在向沙勿略学院当局申请援助期间，将寻找工作直至就业。他无固定住所。

Foreign Section Station,
REPORT
Date April 17, 19 30.
Subject (in full) Lawerence Paterson.
Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by Tho Robertson D.I.

Lawerence Paterson arrived in Shanghai from
Singapore on the s.s. "Beltana" at 11 a.m. April 16th.
He was met on arrival and when interrogated volunteered
the following particulars regarding himself:-
Name, Lawerence Paterson, aged 34, British Eurasian,
born in Shanghai of British father and Chinese mother.
His father was in the Royal marines and died in Shanghai
in 1910. Paterson was educated in the St. Francis
Xaviers College, No. 23 Nanzing Road, and in 1913 left
Shanghai for England. At the outbreak of the Great
War he joined the R.F.A. and served in France until 1918
when he was transferred for Garrison duty in India.
Soon afterwards he was discharged and then proceeded
to Singapore where he obtained a position with the S.P.C.
which he held for about four years and was then discharged
for (according to him) some unknown reason.
As far as could be learned he then commenced a
wandering life and eventually, being in distress, gave
himself up to the Singapore Police who paid his passage
to Shanghai.
Paterson had no money but stated he would apply
to the Xaviers College Authorities for assistance until
such time as he could find employment. He has no
permanent residence.

SECRET

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER SHANGHAI.
No. I. O. D. 11171.
Date...April 14th 1930.
15 - 4 - 30.

My dear Aiers,

A telegram from Singapore informs us that
"Lawrence Peterson, an Eurasian vagrant, left Singapore for
Shanghai on the s.s."Beltana", April 6th.1930."

I do not know why it has been considered necessary
to telegraph this information to us, but pass it on for
what it is worth. Yours sincerely,

W.S. Blackham.

R.C.Aiers, Esq.,
Director of Criminal Investigation,
S.M.Police.

For. Section,
For inquiry and report please
M.B
15/4/30

编号 I. O. D. 11171。
日期...1930年4月14日。
30年4月15日。

亲爱的艾尔斯：

来自新加坡的一份电报通知我们：“欧亚混血流浪者劳伦斯·彼得森，于1930年4月6日乘‘贝尔塔纳’号轮船离开新加坡前往上海。”

我不明白为何认为有必要将此信息电告我们，但现将该信息转达给您，供参考。此致

敬礼，

W.S. 布莱克汉姆。

R.C. 艾尔斯 先生，
刑事调查处处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
